english.note: Use this for the honour or good fortune of having an opportunity to do something, as in ‘It is my privilege’.
Use this formal word for the social sense of being honored, as in being pleased to meet someone.

examples.english: It is my privilege to represent the company at this event.
examples.traditional: 我可以代表公司出席呢個場合，真係好榮幸。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ho2 ji5 doi6 biu2 gung1 si1 ceot1 zik6 ni1 go3 coeng4 hap6 zan1 hai6 hou2 wing4 hang6

examples.english: It is a great pleasure and honor to represent the company at this event.
examples.traditional: 能夠代表公司出席呢個場合，我感到非常榮幸。
examples.jyutping: nang4 gau3 doi6 biu2 gung1 si1 ceot1 zik6 ni1 go3 coeng4 hap6 ngo5 gam2 dou3 fei1 soeng4 wing4 hang6
